en: Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town set on gentle hills with fields and rows of trees in the foreground. A dense cluster of traditional multi‑storey buildings with steep roofs fills the middle, dominated by a large church or town hall tower rising above the skyline. At the bottom of the image, printed in red, is the town name, and in smaller red type below is the name of the publisher and city.
